title: Deadline: Lionsgate Partners with Toei Animation for U.S. Distribution of Projects Including Monkey Quest Film
content: Entertainment news website Deadline reported on Tuesday that Lionsgate is partnering with Toei Animation as its new distribution partner for anime projects in the U.S. The partnership begins with the upcoming Monkey Quest film in 2027. The company will reportedly be considered for future co-productions with Toei .

title: Manga Artist Shin'ichi Abe Dies at 76
content: Musician Kōsei Abe announced on Sunday that his father, manga artist Shin'ichi Abe , had died on September 4 from submandibular gland cancer. The family held a private funeral with close family members. He was 76. Abe began his career in 1970 with the Yasashii Hito manga and was active through the '70s.
